en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abdullah, from Ali Bin Muhammad, from Is’haq Al Jallab who said,

‘I bought a lot of sheep for Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, so he<sup>asws</sup> called me and made me enter into the stables of his<sup>asws</sup> house to a capacious place I did not recognise. So I went on to separate those sheep among the ones he<sup>asws</sup> instructed me with. So I sent to Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> and his<sup>asws</sup> mother, and others from the ones he<sup>asws</sup> instructed me with. Then I sought his<sup>asws</sup> permission regarding leaving to go to Baghdad to my parents, and that was the day of Al-Tarwiyya (8<sup>th</sup> Zilhajj). So he<sup>asws</sup> wrote to me: ‘You should stay tomorrow with us<sup>asws</sup>, then leave’.

He (the narrator) said, ‘So I stayed. When it was the day of Arafat, I stayed with him<sup>asws</sup> and spent the night of Al-Az’ha in a gallery of his<sup>asws</sup>. When it was the pre-dawn, he<sup>asws</sup> came over to me and he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O Is’haq! Arise!’ So I arose and opened my eyes, and there I was upon my door in Baghdad.

Therefore, I went over to my parents and I was among my companions. So I said to them, ‘I spent the day of Arafat (9<sup>th</sup> Zilhajj) in Al-Askar and I came out to be in Baghdad to the Eid (10<sup>th</sup> Zilhajj)’.
